name: testpilot-mcp

tools.name: tp_scan_project
tools.description: Scan a project codebase to extract routes, API endpoints, forms, and auth files. Results are cached to .testpilot/context.json and used by tp_get_context and tp_plan. Run once per project, or after significant structural changes.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to the current working directory.

base_url.description: Override the detected dev-server URL (e.g. "http://localhost:4000"). Auto-detected from .env PORT or framework defaults if omitted.

tools.name: tp_get_context
tools.description: Retrieve source code for a feature, route path, or component name. Returns the relevant files (route, form, API handler, auth) that Claude should read before generating a test plan. Requires tp_scan_project to have run first.

feature.description: Feature, URL path, or component to look up. Examples: "login", "/dashboard/settings", "CheckoutForm", "user signup"

tools.name: tp_plan
tools.description: Generate a step-by-step test plan for a feature using codebase context. Returns ordered Playwright MCP tool calls with expected assertions, real form field names, route paths, and API endpoints from your source code. Requires tp_scan_project to have run first.

feature.description: Feature or user flow to test. Examples: "login flow", "user signup", "checkout", "password reset"

edge_cases.description: Include edge case steps (empty form, invalid input, error states). Default true.

tools.name: tp_start
tools.description: Start a new testpilot session. Loads cached project context from .testpilot/context.json if available, enabling tp_get_context and tp_plan without needing to rescan. Call this before any other tp_ tools.

name.description: Name for this test session (e.g. "Login flow — sprint 4")

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project being tested. Defaults to current working directory.

tools.name: tp_assert
tools.description: Record a pass/fail assertion with optional screenshot proof. Call after each meaningful browser step. Pass the filename you gave to browser_take_screenshot (e.g. "screenshot-step-2.png") — testpilot reads it from /tmp/testpilot-screenshots/ and embeds it in the HTML report.

label.description: Human-readable description of what is being asserted (e.g. "Login page loaded")

passed.description: Whether the assertion passed (true) or failed (false)

screenshot_file.description: Filename of the screenshot taken by browser_take_screenshot (e.g. "screenshot-step-2.png"). testpilot reads it from /tmp/testpilot-screenshots/ and embeds it in the HTML report as visual proof.

tools.name: tp_end
tools.description: End the test session and generate HTML + JSON reports in ./testpilot-reports/. Reports include the full assertion log, step history, and project context summary.

instructions:
testpilot-mcp adds codebase-aware testing on top of Playwright MCP.
It reads your actual source code to generate precise test plans, records pass/fail assertions with screenshots, and produces an HTML report.

REQUIRES: Both testpilot AND @playwright/mcp must be configured as MCP servers.

WORKFLOW — always in this order:
1. tp_scan_project({ path: "/absolute/path/to/project" })
   Indexes the codebase once. Detects framework (Next.js, React Router, Express, etc.),
   extracts routes, API endpoints, form field names, and auth files.
   Caches result to .testpilot/context.json — re-run only after major structural changes.

2. tp_start({ project_path: "/absolute/path/to/project", name: "My test session" })
   Opens a session. Auto-loads the cached scan so context is immediately available.

3. tp_get_context({ feature: "login" })
   Returns the actual source files (route, form component, API handler) relevant to the feature.
   Read these before planning so the test uses real field names and routes.

4. tp_plan({ feature: "login flow", edge_cases: true })
   Generates an ordered list of Playwright MCP tool calls with assertions, real field names,
   and screenshot steps built in. Returns exact tool names to call.

5. Execute each step using Playwright MCP tools:
   browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_fill_form, browser_click,
   browser_take_screenshot, browser_network_requests, browser_console_messages, etc.

6. tp_assert({ label, passed, actual, expected, screenshot_file })
   Record each assertion. For screenshots: pass the filename you gave to
   browser_take_screenshot (e.g. "screenshot-step-2.png") — testpilot reads it from
   /tmp/testpilot-screenshots/ and embeds it as visual proof in the HTML report.

7. tp_end()
   Closes session. Writes HTML + JSON reports to ./testpilot-reports/.
   Returns PASSED / FAILED / NO_ASSERTIONS status.

SCREENSHOT PATTERN:
  browser_take_screenshot({ filename: "screenshot-pageload.png" })   ← Playwright MCP
  tp_assert({ label: "Page loaded", passed: true, screenshot_file: "screenshot-pageload.png" })

EXAMPLE USER PROMPT:
  "Scan the project at /Users/me/myapp, then test the login flow"
  → Claude calls tp_scan_project, tp_start, tp_get_context, tp_plan, then executes all steps.
